nr107-f114r.summary: Boyneburg says a great deal: the Elector is said to have obtained 30,000 thalers 'pro iuribus Erfordensibus' (for the Erfurt rights); he swore to his people 'may the devil take me' and called people to witness it.

system: Simple substitution in Latin letters with a regular key over a 24-letter alphabet: odd plaintext letters -> z y x w ... n (reversed), even -> a b c ... m. Word division kept.
